title: baseline.v1
description: Baseline document: findings that were reviewed and deliberately accepted, each with a written reason. Maintained by `cargo reconverge triage` and applied by `check` to display and to the exit code; the analysis engine never reads it, so findings.v1 stays a faithful record of what was found. Entries match on (crate, kernel, code) and deliberately not on line numbers, which move on the first edit above a finding. Additive-only within v1; consumers must tolerate unknown fields. reconverge-artifacts::baseline is the Rust binding; fixtures/baseline/ are the API tests.

crate.description: Analyzed crate the suppressed finding belongs to.

kernel.description: Kernel the finding is about; absent for crate-level findings, and an entry without a kernel never covers a finding with one.

code.description: Diagnostic code. One entry covers every finding of this code in this kernel.

reason.description: Why the finding is accepted. Required: a suppression without a reason is the silent debt this file exists to prevent.
